help.title: Help
help.heading: ElasticBreath Guide
help.body:
[Quick Start - 30 seconds]
1. Click "Start Work" on the main window to begin a work cycle; click "Start Rest" to rest, or "Stop" to end.
2. Everything else is automatic - the app switches states when you leave or return.

[Four States]
- Idle: Not working. Continuous input for a few seconds auto-starts a work cycle.
- Working: Timer running. Beyond the min-work threshold, a dim orange edge glow appears (Warning); past the max-work threshold it turns into a pulsing alert red (Hard).
- Resting: Timer running. A fresh green edge glow shows; in overtime the green brightens and flashes to signal return.
- Paused: Long inactivity during work freezes progress until you come back.

[Key Design: No Close Button]
Every prompt can only be "completed", never "dismissed" - this is intentional, to stop reminders being habitually ignored. Two ways to complete:
- Click "Start Rest" / "Start Work" on the main window;
- Hover the mouse in the top-left screen corner for ~1.5s: a translucent circle appears at the corner and turns greener the longer you hover; it switches the state the moment it turns green.
After the switch the circle stays green until you move the mouse away.

[Smart Sensing]
- Away detection: No input for the away threshold (default 3 min) auto-pauses; 30s of inactivity during work auto-starts rest.
- Return detection: When activity resumes, a countdown card pops up top-right (default 5s); click the card to cancel.
- Lock screen: Immediately enters rest; today's totals are preserved across midnight.
- Remote control: Detects ToDesk/RayLink/SunLogin and similar foreground apps to suppress false positives.

[Other Features Worth Exploring] - if you want to know more
- Every duration field in Settings accepts expressions like 35*60 (= 35 min); the raw text is kept in the config for easy review.
- Multi-monitor: Pick the primary monitor; secondary monitors flash their borders if you ignore the main one.
- Fullscreen apps: Tries a safe top-most overlay by default; falls back to taskbar flash + optional beep, or hide all overlays via settings.
- Postpone: When work hits Warning/Hard, press "Postpone" to delay once - 3 per day, 5 min cooldown; quota resets after a complete rest (>= 3 min).

[Ideal Use Case]
For long coding, writing or design sessions, keep the GUI on a side monitor / minimized; let the edge glow cue your work duration on the primary screen, and use corner hover to switch to rest without losing focus. Configure once and let it run.

[Data & Privacy]
Fully local - no networking, no data upload. Crash logs are written only to
 %TEMP%\ElasticBreath\crash\ 
and can be opened from the About window.
